System Parameters:
  • Coherence Threshold: Minimum coherence for acceptance
  • Election Speed: ms between elections
  • Backtracking: Allow revising prior decisions
  • User Influence: Weight of user preferences
  • Coherence Decay: Rate of coherence degradation
  • Manifestation: Enable real-world output
  • Prediction Depth: Elections to simulate ahead
